freeze_context: Set after inspecting run-loop seed 11, before human review of the remaining grid. Not a preregistered unseen-data evaluation.
structural_gate: Finite arrays, valid rotations, consistent frame counts and skeleton, editable export; necessary but not evidence of realism.
acceptance_rule: Every applicable measured gate passes; both reviewers score every applicable dimension at least 4; no major defect; required rig/engine checks pass. Missing required measurement means unassessed, never pass. Do not average away a failed category.
proxy_policy: Model-predicted contacts and joint-only penetration are screening proxies. They cannot satisfy independent stance or mesh collision gates. Report unsupported outputs, including absent box motion, separately.
cleanup_policy: Measure active minutes to this same acceptance rubric and record unfinished trials. No arbitrary cleanup-time pass threshold before a matched animator-authored reference exists.
sampling: Five fixed seeds per case; report every seed, median, worst case and success fraction. Five trials are exploratory and do not establish broad reliability.
